## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or operational result.

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting, lint, strict typecheck, tests, and builds pass.
- [ ] Failure, retry, cancellation, idempotency, and tenant boundaries were considered.
- [ ] No secret or private content was added to logs, events, fixtures, or screenshots.
- [ ] Migrations have a tested reversal or an explicit irreversible review.
- [ ] User-visible success is backed by evidence or clearly marked as unverified.

## Risk and rollout

State the risk class, approval requirement, canary plan, and rollback trigger.
